description.en: A deliberately unoptimized product management application built with FastAPI, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Created for educational purposes to demonstrate common performance anti-patterns.
description.es: Una aplicación de gestión de productos deliberadamente inoptimizada construida con FastAPI, React, TypeScript y Tailwind CSS. Creada con fines educativos para demostrar malas prácticas comunes de rendimiento.
